name: Activate a snapshot
context:
POST /snapshots/{id}/activate
Activate a snapshot
Required: id (path) — Snapshot ID
Optional: X-Daytona-Organization-ID (header) — Use with JWT to specify the organization ID

name: Create a new snapshot
context:
POST /snapshots
Create a new snapshot
Required: body (body)
Optional: X-Daytona-Organization-ID (header) — Use with JWT to specify the organization ID

name: Deactivate a snapshot
context:
POST /snapshots/{id}/deactivate
Deactivate a snapshot
Required: id (path) — Snapshot ID
Optional: X-Daytona-Organization-ID (header) — Use with JWT to specify the organization ID

name: List all snapshots
context:
GET /snapshots
List all snapshots
Optional: X-Daytona-Organization-ID (header) — Use with JWT to specify the organization ID; page (query) — Page number of the results; limit (query) — Number of results per page; name (query) — Filter by partial name match; sourceSandboxId (query) — Filter by the ID of the sandbox the snapshot was created from; sort (query) — Field to sort by; order (query) — Direction to sort by

context:

Optional: X-Daytona-Organization-ID (header) — Use with JWT to specify the organization ID
